definitions.full: H3156. Yizrachyah יִזְרַחְיָה proper name, masculine ( ׳י will arise , or shine ) — 1 ᵐ5 Ζαρεια , A Ιεζρια , ᵐ5 L Ιεζερια : — a man of Issachar 1Chr 7:3 (twice in verse). 2 overseer ( הַמָּקִיד ) of the singers Neh 12:42 , ᵐ5 L and others Ιεζριας .
